requirement: The system shall refuse to publish a property listing when the asking price, address and property type have not all been supplied.
The system shall compute the monthly mortgage estimate for a listing from the asking price, the configured interest rate and the standard 25-year repayment term.
The buyer searches listings by location and price range; the system returns matching published listings ordered by how recently they were listed.
The buyer selects a listing and requests a viewing; the system checks the requested slot against the agent's availability and records the viewing request.
As a buyer, I want to save listings to a shortlist so that I can compare properties before deciding.
As a seller, I want to mark a listing as under offer so that further viewings are paused while a deal is being negotiated.
A listing may not be published unless the seller has confirmed ownership of the property through a verified document.
Every change to a listing's asking price or status must be recorded with the previous value, the new value, the acting agent and the timestamp.
The listing table shall ensure that asking price is positive, that status is one of the recognised values, and that a listing cannot have the same address twice in the same agency.
code:
-- property listing table
CREATE TABLE listing (
    listing_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    agency_id       VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    agent_id        VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    seller_id       VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    address         VARCHAR(300)  NOT NULL,
    property_type   VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    asking_price    NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    listed_at       TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT listing_price_positive CHECK (asking_price > 0),
    CONSTRAINT listing_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED','UNDER_OFFER','SOLD','WITHDRAWN')),
    CONSTRAINT listing_type_chk   CHECK (property_type IN ('APARTMENT','HOUSE','LAND','COMMERCIAL')),
    CONSTRAINT listing_agency_address_unique UNIQUE (agency_id, address)
);

CREATE INDEX listing_agency_idx ON listing (agency_id, status);
CREATE INDEX listing_status_idx ON listing (status, listed_at DESC);

-- viewing appointment table
CREATE TABLE viewing (
    viewing_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id    BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    buyer_id      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    agent_id      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    requested_at  TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    status        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT viewing_listing_fk FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listing(listing_id),
    CONSTRAINT viewing_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('REQUESTED','CONFIRMED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED'))
);
-- offer table
CREATE TABLE offer (
    offer_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id  BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    buyer_id    VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    amount      NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    status      VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    submitted_at TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT offer_listing_fk FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listing(listing_id),
    CONSTRAINT offer_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT offer_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('SUBMITTED','ACCEPTED','REJECTED','WITHDRAWN'))
);

requirement: A buyer may only see listings in published state; draft and withdrawn listings must be hidden from buyers, even when the listing id is known.
The weekly marketing report shall list every listing that has been published for more than thirty days with fewer than five enquiries, so the agent can review pricing or presentation.
